title: Neon and LED signs on Portland Street, Mong Kok
lede: Hand-bent neon and LED-dot signs in Chinese characters glow red, yellow, and green against black building facades in Mong Kok, Hong Kong.
summary: Red and green neon tubes and LED-dot characters on a black night ground. Photograph by Benlisquare, Mong Kok, Hong Kong, 2025.

source.label: Wikimedia Commons: LED and neon signs on Portland Street at night.jpg

evidence.note: Downloaded and inspected the Commons 1920 px rendition of the 6000 × 4000 px original. The description reads “An assortment of LED and neon shop signs on Portland Street in Mong Kok at night.”

styles.note: Partial fit: the neon-on-black source of the style’s palette and glow, from the Hong Kong streets that Wikipedia names as a model for the cyberpunk city. It has no HUD or terminal elements.

context: Wikipedia: Ridley Scott envisioned the Los Angeles of [Blade Runner](ref:blade-runner-1982) as “Hong Kong on a very bad day”, and the city of [Ghost in the Shell](ref:ghost-in-the-shell-film-1995) was based on Hong Kong. [Cyberpunk](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cyberpunk).

The photograph is in the Commons categories “Neon signs in Portland Street, Hong Kong” and “Shop signs in Mong Kok”. [Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:LED_and_neon_signs_on_Portland_Street_at_night.jpg).
observed: The ground is black or deep red: unlit facades with air conditioners, pipes, and window frames, lit only by the signs.
A tall vertical neon sign at upper left has orange-yellow characters inside a green neon outline.
Two horizontal signs in the center have characters drawn in orange LED dots on dark blue panels, edged with rows of blue and white dots.
A red neon sign at right, with large characters inside a red tube frame, casts red light over the building above it.
A smaller sign at left has pink-white neon characters over green neon text, including “卡拉OK”.
The halos around the tubes are soft and centered, with no offset.
interpretation: Here the grammar’s “glow, not shadow” is literal: each line is a light source, and its halo spreads evenly on all sides.
The green outline around the yellow vertical sign is the same device as a glowing hairline frame around a panel.
borrow: Draw a frame as a single glowing line in a second color around text of a first color.
Build large characters from dots, as on LED signs, for a display face that reads as light.

images.alt: Shop signs at night in Chinese characters: a tall yellow neon sign with a green outline, two dark panels with orange dot-matrix characters, and a large red neon sign that lights the building red. The facades behind are almost black.
images.caption: LED and neon shop signs on Portland Street, Mong Kok, Hong Kong, 31 July 2025. Photograph by Benlisquare, [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:LED_and_neon_signs_on_Portland_Street_at_night.jpg), CC BY-SA 4.0.

rights.statement: Photograph by Benlisquare, “Own work”, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 on Wikimedia Commons. The subject is a group of commercial shop signs on a public street. Hong Kong’s Copyright Ordinance (s. 71) permits photographs of works of artistic craftsmanship permanently in public places; the lead curator may confirm that this covers neon signs.
